title: SemiDFL: A Semi-Supervised Paradigm for Decentralized Federated Learning

layout.note: Two panels side by side. (a) at the left is a ten-client topology with a legend row beneath. (b) holds a ring of six chevron steps around a grey disc, with a column of three dashed inset boxes to its right that are tied to steps 6, 1 and 3 by dashed leader lines.

lesson: Give detailed zoom insets only to the steps the paper claims as new and tie each to its ring segment with one dashed leader line, so the figure itself marks the contribution. Write toy numbers into the insets (weights that sum to 1) so an operation can be followed by hand.
